songs.title: America Online
lyrics: If I love you, will you love me?
If I want you, will you want me?
I’m reaching, are you reaching out?
If I touch you, will you touch me now?
Through the wires to the heart
Phantom fingers fumble in the dark
I thought I did; I felt a spark
Are we all one beating heart?

songs.title: Dance With Somebody
lyrics: Keeps you glued to your seat
Can we get you you outta your head
It’s not that the rest of us
It’s just that some dance partners need a dance partner too
Life’s too short to dance by yourself
Think you should dance with somebody
You could sit on your hands or
You could get closer if you dare
And it’s not that the rest of us don’t have to fight
For every bit of love for and every bit of light

songs.title: Seventeen
lyrics: I was a runaway and you were a Queen
Our tongues tied in the mezzanine
No strings on you no strings on me
I was a cannonball and you were the sea
When I crashed into your blue dream
Time takes no prisoners, you’ll see
The thought of a spark could start a fire
How we forget how we desire
I was a runaway and you were a jewel
It was Paradise in the land of fools
Time takes no prisoners, you’ll see

songs.title: Dream Away
lyrics: Day dreaming up a good life
That wouldn’t hurt and wouldn’t spoil
In the beauty there was purpose
I could’ve lived this lie forever
I thought I heard you calling
You said I could not stay
And I woke up in a fever
These pillars could not hold us
There’s all the love you need
To make a way for the dark heart
To feel the love I’ve found
There’s all the love you need
The beauty of a just world
And the convenience of a lie
There is no other perfect life
But in the dirt under my fingers

songs.title: Prom Night
lyrics: Do you know what to do
And bridge the two halves of the world
We’ll never pass this way again
A breath as deep as you make
There’s a chance if you take it
And a heart that you break is still a heart
Can you leap from the ledge and bridge the two halves of the world
Prom night turns to daylight rediscovered

songs.title: Fire In The Sky
lyrics: I wasn’t looking for forever or a one night stand
I was just hoping for a smile or a quick slow dance
But when I saw you, there was nothing I could ever do
To ignore the smell of smoke across the room
The room around began to catch fire and disappear
If I burn down would you do the same
I wasn’t looking for a sign
When I touched you your skin was hot and eyes were clear
And the room around began to catch fire and disappear
I told my heart that I would keep it safe and locked away
But I found myself walking to you through the flame
The room around began to catch fire and disappear
I see fire in the sky

songs.title: Monsters
lyrics: Stitched the seams and pull the levers
When just your shadow half remains
And the part of you that died
I held so tight that I lost her
After the one you love is gone
And our love became a void

songs.title: Brooklyn
lyrics: But the skyline shines with a certain light
And I know you’re sick of it
But I know a happy hour nearby
That one day things will get better
For the huddled masses in between
I’ll cover you in winter like a blanket by the fire
And when the rent is too high
And hang on to see if whether
I’d like to take you dancing
That we’ll both go down together
I never placed too much faith in the stars
I never placed too much faith in my heart
But the siren call of the chandelier city
And inch by inch we’re breaking apart
As we’re rising through the dark
From the sky I bet the lights look pretty

songs.title: Deep Blue
lyrics: Might lead me to the wrong hands
I was one of the dark hearts
I said I’ve never felt my heart like this
She said I’ve never felt my body
I always thought the point of love was just
But I found love, I found love like an ocean
Your eyes try to miss me
I didn’t know I had a soul until the moment you kissed me

songs.title: Night Skies
lyrics: Your house is on fire won’t you let me in
Your house is on fire won’t you let me in
The flames burn hotter the deeper you go in
1000 miles an hour, how does it feel?
A million horsepower, no steering wheel
Running off the shoulder, asleep on the stage
Exploding cold steel, fire beauty and rage
Your ship is sinking let me climb aboard
Your ship is sinking let me climb aboard
The flames burning hotter, oh my lord
Your ship is sinking let me climb aboard

songs.title: City Dreams (interlude)
lyrics: Fantastic fall fashions are in our ladies and girls department today.
You can choose from our Hunter's Glen collection.
An array of fashion fall pants, sweaters and shirts, all in the latest styles and colors.
For that sporty look we have a great selection of novelty fleece tops, private labels and labeled jeans.
We also have a terrific selection of girl sweaters and fleece separates to choose from.

songs.title: Last Train
lyrics: Well scotch bottles and the soda guns
You missed the last train from the city tonight
Old friends see each other in a different different light
And two pilgrims seek a makeshift home
You missed the last train from the city tonight
Old friends see each other in a different different light
You missed the last train tonight
The subway rumbles under union square
The morning finds an unlikely pair
Hotel lobby holding hands don’t blink don’t think don’t look in her eyes
Is this forever or is this goodbye
Half in light and half in dark is where we start
Half in light and half in dark is where we are
